sources.label: Patches for use with Morphe by 0x11DFE
sources.author: 0x11DFE
patch_list: Empties the banner, interstitial, rewarded and app-open ad loaders and the rewarded load in the server-row boost button. No ad request leaves the device. Use with 'Unlock Speed Boost' to keep the boost button working.
The session clock always reports 100 years, so sessions never expire. The countdown display shows the infinity sign.

Grants the per-server boost on tap instead of after an interstitial. Same storage, rocket icon and toast as the ad flow. The 3-minute interstitial while connected is gone as well. Use together with 'Remove Ads'.
